user.title: Set up Vector
user.description:
Choose one mode only.

For EscapePod/Wire-pod: Fill Robot name and Host (Serial is optional).

For Digital Dream Labs cloud servers: Fill Robot name, Host, Serial, Email, and Password.

Only fill Email and Password when you want DDL cloud mode. Leave both empty for EscapePod/Wire-pod mode.

error.invalid_robot_name: Robot name must match Vector-ABCD format.
